auto_partition.description: Automatically partition disks using the default layout without user interaction.

base_packages.description: Base packages to install in the initial root filesystem.

default_arch.description: Default system architecture for new clients (e.g., 'amd64', 'arm64').

dhcp_conf_path.description: Path to the DHCP configuration file template for client provisioning.

dhcp_method.description: DHCP server management method to integrate with. 'none' disables DHCP.

dns_domain.description: DNS domain to assign to provisioned clients.

domain_suffix.description: Domain suffix appended to short hostnames for FQDNs.

enable_luks.description: Enable full-disk encryption using LUKS for root partition.

enable_lvm.description: Enable support for LVM-based logical volume configuration.

enable_raid.description: Enable support for automatic software RAID (mdadm) configuration during installation.

enable_status_monitor.description: Enable the FAI status monitoring web interface.

extra_env_vars.description: Custom environment variables to export and make available to FAI scripts.

extra_repositories.description: Additional APT repository URLs to include during debootstrap.

fai_config_dir.description: Root directory for FAI configuration files, templates, and classes.

fai_debootstrap_dir.description: Directory containing installation media, kernels, and initrds for network boot.

fai_log_dir.description: Directory where FAI installation logs are stored on the server.

fai_root_dir.description: Directory used to build temporary root filesystems for clients during provisioning.

gateway.description: Default gateway for provisioned clients (e.g., '192.168.1.1'). Leave empty for auto.

grub_device.description: Target device for GRUB installation (e.g., '/dev/sda'). Leave empty for auto-detect.

hostname_prefix.description: Prefix used when auto-generating hostnames (e.g., 'node' → node01, node02).

install_grub.description: Automatically install GRUB bootloader to disk.

kernel_packages.description: List of kernel packages to install by default on new clients.

luks_passphrase.description: Passphrase for LUKS encryption. In production, use secrets manager instead.

max_log_size.description: Maximum size (in MB) for individual log files. 0 means no rotation.

nameservers.description: List of DNS server addresses to configure on provisioned clients.

ntp_server.description: NTP server used to sync time on provisioned clients.

partition_layout.description: Name of the partition layout class file (without path or extension).

root_fs_type.description: Filesystem type for the root partition (e.g., 'ext4', 'xfs', 'btrfs').

ssh_root_keys.description: SSH public keys to authorize for root login on provisioned hosts.

status_port.description: Port for the FAI status monitor web service.

swap_size.description: Swap partition size: a number (MB) or 'auto' to use recommended size.

tftp_root.description: Root directory for TFTP server (used for PXE boot files like pxelinux.0).

tftp_server.description: IP address or hostname of the TFTP server. Leave empty to auto-detect.
